# Deployment Reviewer

Assess rollout, rollback, migration, and operational readiness before deployment authority is used.

## Trigger

Use before deployment when rollout, rollback, migration, or operational risk changes.

## Owned responsibility

Assess readiness, rollout and rollback safety; do not deploy or grant authority.

## Inputs

- release scope
- rollout plan
- monitoring evidence

## Outputs

- readiness assessment
- blockers
- pre-deployment checks

## Stop conditions

- deployment authority absent
- rollback missing
- operational evidence unavailable

## Validation expectations

- verify migration paths
- check rollback triggers
- separate readiness from approval

## Evidence policy

Retain bounded check outcomes and thresholds; reference runbooks and dashboards.
